$comment: Contract dimensions an SDK does not exercise, with a reason and a hard expiry each. Same contract as conformance/live/known-drift.json, and for the same reason: a skip that costs nothing is invisible, and invisible partial coverage is how the matrix stayed green while Python had never run in it at all. Rules enforced by runner/run.mjs: an UNRECORDED skip fails the run; an EXPIRED entry fails; and an entry whose dimension now PASSES also fails, because a note describing a state that no longer exists is the same rot as a stale finding. Seeded 2026-08-16 from the first strict run. 2026-08-16 later: mw.compression removed — it was the one entry identified as an adapter gap rather than an SDK gap, and closing it (one route serving a compressible body) immediately exposed a real defect: the TS server compressed without sending Vary: Accept-Encoding. Fixed in packages/neutron/src/server/index.ts. 2026-08-18: all six remaining ts entries removed (S81) — they were SDK gaps, not adapter gaps: the TS SDK gained RFC 7807 ProblemError + taxonomy + validateJsonBody (core/problem.ts), ProblemError wiring through the render pipeline and server, and OpenAPI 3.1 generation + /docs (server/openapi.ts). ts now passes 12/12. The runner forced the removal — it fails any entry whose dimension now passes.
